comment: TRIMMED fixture. Captured on the Strix Halo probe machine with `vulkaninfo --json=/tmp/vk2.json` (Vulkan Profiles schema; full file ~390 KB). Only the JSON paths xrocmtop's parser reads are kept: capabilities.device.properties.{VkPhysicalDeviceProperties.deviceName,apiVersion; VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Properties.driverName,driverInfo}. The live profiles output omits memory heaps, so a realistic VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties.memoryHeaps block (real sizes from `vulkaninfo --text`) was added under the device node so the heap parser is exercised; older/other vulkaninfo schemas emit this block.

VkPhysicalDeviceProperties.comment: apiVersion 4211023 decodes via VK_VERSION macros to 1.4.335
